items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: I saw him last week at Dizzy’s with Lonnie Smith.

ctx.x: I saw him last week at Dizzy’s with Lonnie Smith. It’s Fathead. It’s not like we’re talking about some guy that plays weddings in Wyoming, it’s Fathead. Beautiful, and a beautiful cat. Did not deserve that portrayal. But I thought the movie by and large was pretty good.
What do you think about the digital downloading business?
